quality_probes.text: The history of computing includes mechanical calculators, electronic computers, and modern software. A computer executes instructions and stores information in memory. Engineers balance speed, energy, cost, and reliability when designing a new system.

Attention computes a weighted combination of values from queries and keys. A transformer uses attention together with feed-forward layers, normalization, and residual connections. During autoregressive generation, cached keys and values avoid repeating earlier work.
